description: This Java source file defines the `LoanReAgeParameter` entity class for the Fineract project. It models parameters related to re-aging a loan, including transaction details, frequency type, start date, and installment count. The class uses JPA annotations for persistence and Lombok annotations for boilerplate code reduction.

classes.name: LoanReAgeParameter
classes.description: JPA entity representing re-age parameters for a loan, including frequency, start date, installment count, and related loan transaction. It extends an auditable base class for tracking audit information.

methods.name: getCopy
methods.description: Creates a copy of the current `LoanReAgeParameter` with a new `LoanTransaction`. Useful for cloning the object with a different transaction context.
